+    def _update_selection_poly(self, vmin, vmax):

+        Update the vertices of the *self.poly* slider in-place
+        to cover the data range *vmin*, *vmax*.
+        """
+        # The vertices are positioned
+        #  1 ------ 2
+        #  |        |
+        #  0, 4 --- 3
+        # Note that the closing vertex (index 4, which is identical to
+        # index 0) may or may not be present in ``self.poly.xy``: whether
+        # or not it is present depends on whether the *vmin* == *vmax*
+        # edge case previously caused Matplotlib to elide the duplicated
+        # point, so we always rebuild all five vertices from scratch
+        # instead of trying to update them in-place.
+        if self.orientation == "vertical":
+            xy = [[.25, vmin], [.25, vmax], [.75, vmax], [.75, vmin],
+                  [.25, vmin]]
+        else:
+            xy = [[vmin, .25], [vmin, .75], [vmax, .75], [vmax, .25],
+                  [vmin, .25]]
+        self.poly.xy = xy
